'''Vakar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] and from the [[House Traders' Circle]] asked a fellow Republic citizen to strike a final blow to the opposition in [[King's Pass]].
